verdicts.reason: A: the BACK BY DEMAND and SUMMER ONLY badges are blown up into full-width pills with text as big as the CTA's, so the CTA is no longer the clear action. The SOLSTICE wordmark is enlarged and placed under the headline, which breaks the reading order. There is dead space at the top, and a cropped fragment of the background circle sits behind SUMMER ONLY at the bottom-left. B: the badges are smaller and narrower than the CTA, so the hierarchy is better. It still has SOLSTICE under the headline, an awkward 3-line headline break ('Mint is / back'), an orphaned 'sweet.' in the subcopy, a small phone, and the same stray circle fragment behind the bottom badge.
